title: エルムSの後に・がまん、がまん！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara places first. However, instead of her usual excitement, she urges me to take her back to the dorms immediately for more training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She says she's so happy she could dance, but she also wants to aim for even more first-place victories. The celebrations will have to wait.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In addition, she says she wants to enter more G1 races, and, well, who am I to ignore such a request?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So I decide to enter her in a type of race that she's good at: A sprint on a dirt course called the JBC Sprint.
